source.stem:
One method of preventing the rusting of iron is to keep oxygen away from the surface of the metal.

Which way of rust prevention does not use this method?

options.text: connecting the iron to a more reactive metal

intelligence.enrichment: Mass is measured with a balance, which must be brought to zero by tare or reset when needed; liquid volume is measured with a measuring cylinder, whose capacity and smallest division set what it can read. Zeroing the balance and reading the measuring cylinder correctly produce usable mass and volume measurements for later density calculations. The learner correctly applies this rule: Mass is measured with a balance, which must be brought to zero by tare or reset when needed; liquid volume is measured with a measuring cylinder, whose capacity and smallest division set what it can read. The displayed balance number and any meniscus mark can be read directly because the instrument already gives the measurement.
